inputs.text:
A seamless hand-painted fantasy mobile RPG sky background, wide aerial view looking steeply down. One lonely small floating island with a lush ancient tree in the FAR UPPER RIGHT CORNER, entirely above the top third of the image. Keep this exact composition and distant size. A very full domed crown of vivid green leaves seen from above, short hidden trunk, a crescent of sunny grass, pale rocks and tangled roots around the edge of the small island. The island is surrounded by clear blue air and appears very far from the viewer.

The sky and clouds flow smoothly and continuously across the whole painting. Beautiful delicate soft wisps and fluffy white cumulus clouds far below, unified clear blue colors and natural softly blended gradients, warm diffuse sunlight from upper left. A vast quiet open blue area below the island, across the center and lower half. Everything has consistent painterly brushwork and lighting. High quality detailed cozy fantasy illustration, a serene high altitude sky voyage, dense fresh yellow-green and emerald leaves. No ships, no people, no buildings, no extra islands, no text, no border, no rectangular panels, no seams. Portrait 9:16 composition with only a small tree island far away at the upper right.
